author_axis.author: Human-approved Supervisor checkpoint protocol
author_axis.component: Existing checkpoint assessment and scheduler integration
author_axis.not_claimed: Autonomous R source evolution, scientific choice or prediction improvement

observed_baseline.credit_route_coupling: Credit0 only invalid/cooldown-or-stop;1 only inconclusive/bounded_followup;2 support/continue or refute/stop-cooldown, with refute/branch opt-in v3.
observed_baseline.legacy_duplicate_guard: question_id/question_digest or same problem+evidence_bundle; no separate canonical finding/reuse record.
observed_baseline.new_diagnostic: Current synthetic actual functions reproduce valid0 exclusion without file writes, fits or consumer invocation.

required_source_admission_checks: Explicit new opt-in schema/version only. Legacy v1-v3 initialization, event validation, canonical replay/state hashes, public API defaults and old packets/claims remain identical; no silent migration or relabeling old REFUTED/REVERT/credit.

Separate execution validity, frozen predictor replacement, evidence-based learning assessment and development/branch disposition. KEEP alone updates incumbent; credit never adds to Brier, overrides fixed judge or implies learning success.

Valid zero-credit/non-improving REVERT may retain code and become a parent for a justified distinct bounded question. Invalid/leaked/missing/failed execution is not valid prediction evidence; verified diagnosis/repair learning requires its own specific reviewed artifacts, not automatic reward for failure or code existence.

Learning0 for activity/no new verifiable evidence,1 for independently verifiable relevant nonduplicate finding,2 for a valid key-hypothesis test or validated reusable research capability; gains, significance, sign stability, model/paper/call counts or word count alone do not determine credit.

Stable canonical finding identity and evidence references prevent re-crediting the same finding under fresh question/source names. Preserve duplicates as history with zero new credit; truthful reuse records cite an existing accepted finding plus concrete later action/evidence and distinguish proposed from observed/validated reuse.

Reasonable first small hypothesis needs neither positive prior score nor prior learning credit. Its bounded allowance is durable and consumed by a scheduled/failed attempt; prevent alias-based allowance reset, exact recipe repeats, restoring consumed legacy C2 or bypassing global/per-pilot caps.

Keep global active pool capacity2-3 and method-diverse selection; do not mechanically choose top scores/credit or retain three descendants per parent. Exploration eligibility is not mandatory active membership or automatic continuation of a refuted exact question.

Core receipt/metadata bound to independent result/evidence/source/predeclared question and trusted Supervisor verification, not Controller self-rating. New replay checks must validate exact strict fields/types/finite values/order/hash/idempotence.

Actual new assessment and reuse reach canonical feedback and consumer parent eligibility, not a standalone unconsumed log. Consumer integration follows independently admitted core; legacy transport/schema/once-claim/source checks/original completion recovery remain unchanged.

Original clock/cap/scope guards remain fixed and all old ledgers/records/artifacts are read-only. New exploratory or reuse flags cannot grant data/network/model/provider/release authority or reopen a closed budget.

Matched synthetic success/failure/repaired-child/restart/history tests plus complete inherited recorder suite. Pure legacy closed-chain replay must reproduce old states/hashes without filesystem recovery writes; no real fit/call is needed or admitted here.

Freeze exact modules/tests and measured diff before final core review; later consumer review binds exact integrated snapshot. Unexpected file/dependency/tool/runtime/evaluator/authority change rejects; preserve failed child/source evidence instead of rewriting history.

smallness.scope_admitted: At most two core production modules, one checkpoint-assessment/scheduling H component, exact declared test/log paths.
smallness.warning_trigger: More than about200 changed production lines or more than2 modules requires explicit final semantic inseparability judgment or split; no cosmetic compression/removal of guards.
smallness.prospective_rationale: A pure assessment helper plus existing recorder can be inseparable because persistence, replay and scheduling must share one validated assessment. No final line-count or source verdict issued before actual diff.
smallness.consumer_checkpoint: Subsequent single consumer integration is separately checkpointed/reviewed; the three-module final integration does not waive the core warning or merge scientific R/predictor changes.
smallness.forbidden: New general reward service, reinforcement learning, large harness restructuring, research method menu or per-round authorization/governance expansion.

observed_state_caveat: Protected RESEARCH_STATE.md still describes an expired eight-hour live window; current immutable completed-batch ledgers/reviews are authoritative for this code-only work. It is not edited or used to revive64/256.

actual_checks.test_suite_status: No new/full test suite claimed; exact final core and integrated tests are future required steps.

evidence_level: Prospective code scope only; baseline defect independently reproduced. Requested future L2 synthetic matched operational separation, not L3 live learning/prediction benefit or L4 mechanism superiority.
limitations: No source exists/admitted yet; final exact-source review remains required.
